svg.aria-label: A recording-style demo of the cloudmail inbox. A new message from Maya Chen arrives in the support mailbox; the AI reads it, writes a one-line summary and files it under Billing. The thread is opened, its Summary is written as three points, and a reply is drafted under the message. A notification says a connected app, Claude, asked to send a reply; it waits in Pending approval with the exact message. A person clicks Approve and send, the queue empties, and a notice says Approved and sent.
